name: X7+
summary: The A.O. Smith X7+ is an advanced 8-stage RO water purifier with Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) that delivers 100% RO purified, Baby-Safe water .
intro: The A.O. Smith X7+ is a premium 8-stage RO water purifier featuring Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) and a patented Side Stream RO Membrane for Baby-Safe drinking water. Designed for all water sources—including borewell, tanker, and municipal water—it purifies water with TDS levels up to 3000 ppm. With a 9L food-grade storage tank, digital display, and wall/table-top installation, it delivers reliable, high-quality purification for every home.
